title.zh: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory nod to launch institutional crypto custody solutions
title.en: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory nod to launch institutional crypto custody solutions

current_state.zh: Deutsche Bank is awaiting regulatory approval to launch institutional crypto custody in Europe, initially supporting Bitcoin, Ether, USDC, EURC, and EURAU before expanding into tokenized assets.
